article1.title: Article 1 (Purpose)
article1.paragraph1: These terms and conditions (the "Terms") govern the use of Pantl110 and related services (web/mobile/API/agent/plugin, hereinafter "Services") provided by Amplab Inc. (hereinafter "Company") and establish the rights, obligations, responsibilities, personal information and data processing, fees and refunds, and dispute resolution between the Company and Users (individuals/sole proprietors/corporations/public institutions).

article2.title: Article 2 (Definitions)
article2.item1: "User" means any person (individual/sole proprietor/corporation/public institution) who accesses the Services and receives service provision in accordance with these Terms.
article2.item2: "Administrator/Member" refers to roles with permissions within corporate/institutional accounts.
article2.item3: "Customer Data" means all information (including personal/credit/business information) and processing results uploaded/created/linked by Users to the Services.
article2.item4: "Sub-processor" means subcontractors entrusted by the Company (cloud/IaaS, transmission/notification, model providers, etc.).
article2.item5: "AI Services" includes all generative/analytical AI, automation, OCR/STT/vision, etc.
article2.item6: "Data Value Program" (rewards/credits/coins, etc.) refers to a benefit system that may be provided as compensation for providing anonymized/pseudonymized statistics/insights.
article2.item7: "B2G" means transactions/provision with public/government/public corporations, etc.
article2.item8: "Free Trial" is a form where functions can be used free of charge for a certain period.
article2.item9: "Workspace" is an organizational unit space (including projects, documents, logs, payments, permissions).
article2.item10: "API Service" means programmatic access through the Company's OpenAPI.

article3.title: Article 3 (Effectiveness·Amendment·Notice)
article3.item1: These Terms become effective when Users agree to the terms on the web/app and membership is approved.
article3.item2: The Company posts the Terms on the service initial screen and policy center.
article3.item3: When amending, the Company shall notify 7 days in advance specifying the effective date and reason for amendment, and notify 30 days in advance for changes unfavorable to Users.
article3.item4: If there is no explicit rejection until the effective date after notice, it is deemed agreed. Users may terminate if they do not agree.

article4.title: Article 4 (Individual Terms·Policies)
article4.item1: Privacy Policy, Security Policy, API Terms, Sub-processor Disclosure List, Service Level Policy (SLA, paid only), Data Value Program Policy, Marketing Reception Policy, etc. apply.
article4.item2: In case of conflict, individual terms/written contracts take precedence over these Terms.

article5.title: Article 5 (Registration·Qualification·Account Security)
article5.item1: Registration is done through procedures determined by the Company (email/social/mobile/two-factor authentication, etc.).
article5.item2: Minors require consent from legal representatives.
article5.item3: Users are responsible for managing accounts and passwords, and sharing with third parties is prohibited (account sharing is prohibited even within the same corporation).

article6.title: Article 6 (Service Content)
article6.item1Strong: automatic collection (camera/CCTV/sensors/smartwatch/OCR/STT, etc.) → standardization → AI analysis → profitability-centered management decision support
article6.item2: Modular MES/ERP architecture allows selection and combination of necessary functions only, and is used on PC/tablet/mobile based on cloud.
article6.item3: May include API, third-party integration, agents/plugins, dashboards, documents/electronic tax invoices/settlement, logs/audit records, etc.

article7.title: Article 7 (Free Trial·Beta)
article7.item1: Free trials and beta services may be provided/discontinued at the Company's discretion, and data transfer/preservation/availability are not guaranteed.
article7.item2Part1: Beta features may have frequent errors/changes and are not subject to

article8.title: Article 8 (Fees·Payment·Refund)
article8.item1: Pricing plans (monthly/annual, user/usage-based), API points, additional storage capacity, etc., pricing/payment methods/taxes/auto-renewal follow the Pricing Policy.
article8.item2: Withdrawal/refund follows relevant laws and the Refund Policy (including separate regulations for regular payments/annual discounts/API points).
article8.item3: In case of non-payment, suspension/termination/data deletion may occur after retry attempts (after notice).
article8.item4: B2G/Enterprise takes precedence with separate contract conditions.

article9.title: Article 9 (Data Storage·Security·Availability)
article9.item1: Customer Data is stored in cloud infrastructure, and Region follows policy/contract.
article9.item2: The Company applies industry-standard technical and administrative protective measures and discloses/updates the Sub-processor List.
article9.item3: Availability is specified in SLA for paid users only, including monthly availability targets (e.g., 99.9%) and credit compensation criteria.
article9.item4: May be suspended for unavoidable reasons such as regular maintenance/failures/force majeure, with prior/subsequent notice.

article10.title: Article 10 (Personal Information and Credit/Business Information Protection)
article10.item1: Complies with relevant laws (PIPA, Credit Information Act, etc.) and the Privacy Policy.
article10.item2: Users must ensure legal authority and notice when entering third-party personal information.
article10.item3: Exercise of data subject rights (access/correction/deletion/processing suspension/reception refusal, etc.) follows the policy.

article11.title: Article 11 (Data Processing·AI Learning·Logs)
article11.item1: The Company may process Customer Data within the scope of purposes: provision·maintenance·improvement·security·customer support·billing/settlement·new feature development·statistics/research.
article11.item2: AI model training uses only anonymized/pseudonymized processed data and ensures that individuals or specific companies cannot be identified.
article11.item3: When Users explicitly permit (feedback button, opt-in program, etc.), sampled inputs/outputs may be reviewed limited to model improvement.
article11.item4: Access and processing history are stored as audit logs (retention period follows policy/contract).

article12.title: Article 12 (Data Value Program·Data Transactions)
article12.item1: The Company may operate a Data Value Program, and participation proceeds after separate notice and consent (compensation: credits/coins/in-kind, etc.).
article12.item2: B2B/B2G insights/report provision is performed only with anonymized/pseudonymized processing. Raw data provision is原则上 prohibited, and exceptions require contract/consent/legal basis as requirements.
article12.item3: Tax and accounting processing responsibility for rewards follows the policy.

article13.title: Article 13 (AI Service Fair Use·Output Caution)
article13.item1: Fair Use Policy: Temporary restriction/blocking/pricing plan upgrade requests are possible for excessive calls/automation abuse/system load, and permanent restriction may be applied for repeated violations.
article13.item2: Users should be aware of non-uniqueness/hallucination possibilities of outputs, and important decisions require separate verification. The Company does not guarantee accuracy/suitability/infringement.

article14.title: Article 14 (Prohibited Acts)
article14.item1: Prohibits violation of laws/terms, infringement of others' rights, reverse engineering/scraping/unauthorized crawling, account sharing/transfer, spam/malware distribution, abuse for building competing models/databases, unauthorized automated bulk processing, etc.
article14.item2: Violations may result in warnings/temporary suspension/termination/legal action.

article15.title: Article 15 (Intellectual Property Rights·License·Feedback)
article15.item1: IP of Services and provided materials belongs to the Company.
article15.item2: Rights to Customer Data belong to Users, but use·pseudonymized/anonymized processing is permitted within the scope of these Terms and policies.
article15.item3: Suggestions/feedback provided by Users grant the Company a royalty-free worldwide license.
article15.item4: Reference Use: The Company may display User company names/logos as references, and will stop if Users refuse.

article16.title: Article 16 (Third Party·API·Integration)
article16.item1: When integrating external services/hardware/open APIs, the terms/policies of the relevant suppliers must also be complied with.
article16.item2: The Company is not responsible for damages caused by third-party failures/changes (excluded for separate contracts).
article16.item3: API keys/secret keys are managed under User responsibility.

article17.title: Article 17 (B2G Special Terms)
article17.item1: For B2G transactions, individual contracts take precedence regarding security levels, data storage/export, supervision/audit, availability, delivery/inspection, ordering party policies, etc.
article17.item2: Cooperates with security certification/physical control/data submission required by laws/policies.

article18.title: Article 18 (Advertising Information Reception)
article18.item1: Users may agree to receive advertising information for profit purposes when agreeing to terms/privacy policy.
article18.item2: Reception refusal is possible at any time (no effect on messages sent before withdrawal).

article19.title: Article 19 (Contract Termination·Withdrawal·Data Preservation/Destruction)
article19.item1: Users may terminate/withdraw at any time.
article19.item2: Upon termination, destruction without delay except for preservation obligations under relevant laws/policies.
article19.item3: Enterprise/B2G applies data export/preservation/destruction regulations in contracts first.

article20.title: Article 20 (Disclaimer of Warranty)
article20.item1: Services are provided "as is." No implied warranty is made regarding suitability for specific purposes/non-infringement/uninterrupted availability, etc. (except for paid SLA specified scope).
article20.item2: Beta/free features are not subject to compensation.

article21.title: Article 21 (Damages·Liability Limitation·Exemption)
article21.item1: Except for the Company's intent or gross negligence, the Company is not liable for indirect/special/consequential damages, lost profits, or data loss.
article21.item2: For paid users, the Company's total liability is limited to the limit of actual paid usage fees for the most recent 12 months (excluded for separate contracts).
article21.item3: Force majeure such as natural disasters/war/power outages/telecommunications carrier failures/cloud/IaaS failures are exempted.
article21.item4: If third-party disputes arise due to User violations/negligence, Users must exempt the Company and compensate for damages.

article22.title: Article 22 (Dispute Resolution·Governing Law·Jurisdiction)
article22.item1: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea.
article22.item2: Disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of Seoul Central District Court as the court of first instance.
article22.item3: For disputes with overseas resident Users, KCAB International Arbitration may be selected by agreement of the parties (Seoul, arbitration rules, Korean or English).

article23.title: Article 23 (Export·Sanctions·Anti-Corruption)
article23.item1: Users must comply with relevant laws such as export controls/sanctions (e.g., U.S. EAR, OFAC) and anti-corruption (e.g., FCPA).
article23.item2: Provision/use to sanctioned/prohibited persons/countries is prohibited.

article24.title: Article 24 (Language)
article24.item1: The Company's notices/notifications are in Korean. English translations may be provided for convenience, and in case of discrepancy, the Korean version takes precedence.
article24.item2: Overseas Users may choose Korean/English only for communication with the Company.

article1.paragraph1Continued: and all related services (web, mobile, API, cloud, on-device agents, etc.) provided by Amplab Inc. (hereinafter referred to as "the Company").
article1.paragraph2: The Company complies with relevant laws and regulations such as the Personal Information Protection Act and strives to safely protect users' personal information.

article2.title: Article 2 (Personal Information Items Processed and Collection Methods)
article2.section1Item1: Service registration, paid payments, and tax invoice issuance
article2.section1Item2: Account registration for clients (corporations/individual businesses), input of manager information
article2.section1Item3: Cloud integration, dashboard input, API calls, and automatic log generation
article2.section1Item4: Customer service inquiries, emails, surveys, and marketing consent, etc.
article2.section2Item1: (Required) Name, job title, email, mobile phone number, company name, business registration number, account ID, password
article2.section2Item2: (Optional) Department, position, payment information (card company name/billing address, etc.), customer service inquiry content, log/device information (IP, browser, access records)
article2.section2Item3: (System Collection) AI·OCR·STT input data, document/file metadata, API call records, error logs
article2.section2Item4Continued: , and video/audio data is used only as internal manufacturing data within the company.

article3.title: Article 3 (Purpose of Processing Personal Information)
article3.paragraph: The Company processes collected information for the following purposes:
article3.item1: Contract Performance and Service Provision – Account management, authentication, customized dashboard configuration
article3.item2: Billing and Payment Management – Tax invoice issuance, settlement, refund processing
article3.item3: Service Maintenance and Quality Improvement – Failure response, error log analysis, R&D statistics
article3.item4: Security and Access Control – Anomaly detection, authentication, account protection
article3.item5: Customer Support and Counseling – Inquiry response, notice delivery
article3.item6: B2B·B2G Report Provision – Business data analysis and insights based on pseudonymization
article3.item7: Marketing and Event Notifications (Optional) – New service and promotion promotion (can be refused at any time)

article4.title: Article 4 (Retention and Use Period of Personal Information)
article4.paragraph1: In principle, personal information is destroyed without delay when service use is terminated or membership is withdrawn.
article4.paragraph2: However, the following items are exceptionally retained in accordance with laws or internal policies.

article5.title: Article 5 (Third-Party Provision and Processing Entrustment of Personal Information)
article5.paragraph1: The Company does not provide personal information to third parties without user consent in principle.
article5.paragraph3: When transferring overseas, protective measures in accordance with EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) are applied.

article6.title: Article 6 (User Rights and Exercise Methods)
article6.rights: access, correction, deletion, processing suspension, and refusal to receive
article6.paragraph1Continued: regarding their personal information at any time. Users can request to refuse receipt.
article6.paragraph3: For residents of EU/EEA and California, GDPR and CPRA rights are additionally guaranteed.
article6.item1: Right to access and data portability (Art.20), right to object to automated decision-making (Art.22), right to erasure (Art.17)
article6.item2: Do Not Sell / Share rights and Opt-out link provision

article7.title: Article 7 (Operation of Cookies and Logs)
article7.paragraph1: The service uses essential cookies for login session maintenance and analysis.
article7.paragraph2: Marketing cookies are stored only after prior consent and can be refused in browser settings.
article7.paragraph3: Log data (IP, access time, browser type, etc.) is stored only for security and statistical purposes.

article8.title: Article 8 (Destruction Procedures and Methods of Personal Information)
article8.paragraph1: Personal information is destroyed without delay after the collection purpose is achieved or the retention period expires.
article8.paragraph2: Electronic files are permanently deleted in an irrecoverable manner, and printed materials are shredded or incinerated.
article8.paragraph3: Automatic backup data is sequentially deleted on a 90-day cycle.

article9.title: Article 9 (Measures to Ensure Safety of Personal Information)
article9.paragraph: The Company implements the following technical, administrative, and physical measures:
article9.item1Description: : AES-256 encryption, SSL/TLS transmission, firewall·IDS/IPS operation, access control
article9.item2Description: : Principle of least privilege, regular security education, annual vulnerability inspection
article9.item3Description: : Server room access control, CCTV management, security access management
article9.item4Description: : Immediate isolation upon detection of anomalies → DPO report → notification within 72 hours (GDPR compliance)

article10.title: Article 10 (Protection of Children's Personal Information)
article10.paragraph1: Pantl110 does not provide services to children under the age of 14.
article10.paragraph2: Upon confirmation, service restrictions and personal information are immediately deleted.

article11.title: Article 11 (Automated Decision-Making and Profiling)
article11.paragraph1: AI models are for statistics and recommendations based on business operation data,
article11.noPersonalDecision: and do not affect individual decision-making.
article11.paragraph2: Users can request explanations and exercise the right to object regarding model results (responded to upon email request).

article12.paragraph2: When transferring overseas, Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) and additional protective measures (encryption/access control) are applied.
